title: GET /Users/{userId}/Views lists the caller's libraries, for the apps that still ask there
description: The Kodi add-on, Plezy and Tsukimi list a viewer's libraries through GET /Users/{userId}/Views, the user-scoped form of GET /UserViews, and jellyscale answers 404, so their viewers see no library. The owner decided (2026-11-20, D-033) to serve it as an exception to PRODUCT.md's rule that aliases exist only for routes jellyfin-web calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Observed first on a real Jellyfin 12.4, recorded in compat/captures: whether its OpenAPI document marks GET /Users/{userId}/Views obsolete; its answer for the caller's own id beside GET /UserViews?userId= for the same user, with each query parameter /UserViews takes; and its status for another user's id, an id that is no user and a malformed id

If 12.4 does not mark the route obsolete it is served as an ordinary route, is not flagged alias, and PRODUCT.md's alias rule is left as it was; if it does, the route is flagged alias in compat/endpoints.yaml naming the Kodi add-on, Plezy and Tsukimi, and PRODUCT.md carries the exception (D-033; the owner reviews the text)

With the caller's own id (dashed or compact, any letter case) the route answers the same body as GET /UserViews?userId={userId}, for every query parameter /UserViews honours, with two libraries as well as one

A user id in the path that is not the caller's answers 403 by JS-127's guard, administrators included, and nothing is read for the other user; no token answers 401; TestAccess covers the route as an 'own' viewer route

Read from source first, as D-030 did, with commit and line: whether Plezy's and Tsukimi's players send their token on every media request. docs/status.md lists each under 'sends its token' or 'not supported (D-026)' accordingly and never says either works; no further work goes in for an app whose player sends none

The differential tier asks both servers the route with the signed-in user's id, and any kept difference is in compat/differences.yaml with its reason; compat/coverage-12.4.tsv and docs/status.md name the route and the three clients
docs/access.md's 'Stricter than Jellyfin' table lists every difference compat/captures/user-scope-12.4.md holds (D-087).
notes: No route beyond this one is added for these apps. Kodi stays not a gate; mpv-shim's browser may benefit and is not a target. Dropped (D-126 and the pivot, D-107): An alias for Jellyfin apps (rules 3 and 4). Both auditors agreed.
